# Synthetic PDF fixtures

Generated by scripts/fixtures-pdf.py from a deterministic object/xref writer and repository-generated photo.jpg. No personal or remote documents are included. Native QPDF makes the encrypted-empty-password and object-stream variants. Hidden signature, malformed-xref and oversized-budget cases are deliberate rejection fixtures. Text, metadata, form values, attachments and action/script sentinels are synthetic; preview tests must never execute actions. Original and output validity/stream inventories are independently checked with native QPDF and pages rendered with Poppler.
